about.title: About Me
about.intro: I'm Ham Zhi Wei, a final-year Bachelor of Computer Science (Multimedia Computing) student at the University of Malaya. Through internships and academic projects, I have built customer-facing and internal web apps with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, and SQL. I enjoy turning ideas into interactive digital experiences, collaborating with designers and developers, and learning technologies that help me ship products people actually want to use.
about.focus: Completing my final year, strengthening full-stack skills from recent internships, and building a portfolio that shows how I solve real product problems.
about.goal: Grow as a frontend / full-stack developer and creative technologist, building products with clear UX and solid engineering.
